name: dcp
description: Dynamic context pruning: the model compresses closed conversation ranges into summaries; the session is forked and switched to apply them

maxContextLimit.title: Max context limit
maxContextLimit.description: Above this, every turn end demands aggressive compression and tool results carry a nudge. Tokens (150000) or % of the model window (75%). Keep above the min. Optional: raise to tolerate larger contexts.

minContextLimit.title: Min context limit
minContextLimit.description: Below this, turn ends only drop dead ranges (summaries capped at 200 characters); above it, they merge and paraphrase. Tokens (100000) or % of the model window (50%). Optional: lower to compress sooner.

nudgeFrequency.title: Nudge frequency
nudgeFrequency.description: Tool results between repeated nudges while context is over the max. Integer ≥ 1. Optional: raise if nudges are noisy.

summaryBuffer.title: Summary buffer
summaryBuffer.description: Add the tokens your summaries hold to the max, so they don't trigger aggressive compression. true/false. Optional: keep on.

archiveDays.title: Archive days
archiveDays.description: Days a compressed-away session stays restorable (/dcp-sessions, /dcp-restore) before deletion. Integer ≥ 0; 0 deletes it at once. Optional: raise to keep the undo longer.

protectedTools.title: Protected tools
protectedTools.description: Tools whose outputs are kept verbatim when their range is compressed. Names or globs (mcp__*). Optional: add tools whose exact output you need later.

protectedFilePatterns.title: Protected file patterns
protectedFilePatterns.description: Calls touching files matching these globs (src/**/*.ts) keep outputs verbatim when compressed and are never deduplicated or purged. Optional: empty by default.

protectUserMessages.title: Protect user messages
protectUserMessages.description: Copy your messages verbatim into the summary of their range. true/false. Optional: on costs tokens.

protectTags.title: Protect <protect> tags
protectTags.description: Copy text you wrap in <protect>…</protect> verbatim into summaries. true/false. Optional.

deduplication.title: Deduplication
deduplication.description: At each fork, replace outputs of repeated identical tool calls (same tool, same arguments) except the latest. true/false. Optional: keep on.

purgeErrors.title: Purge errors
purgeErrors.description: At each fork, replace inputs of failed tool calls older than the turns set below. true/false. Optional: keep on.

purgeErrorsTurns.title: Purge errors after turns
purgeErrorsTurns.description: Assistant turns a failed call must age before its input is purged. Integer ≥ 1. Optional.
